summary: Phase 35 'Bulk Fetch & Local Storage' architecture validated end-to-end. All 5 spec points + status endpoint + restart-persistence pass. Frontend /previsions regression also clean.
critical_code_review_comments: severe.py imports `asyncio`, `json`, `Path` mid-file (after function defs) with noqa E402. Cosmetic only — could be hoisted to the top for cleanliness, but not blocking.
_get_or_refresh_bulk() correctly serialises concurrent first-callers behind an asyncio.Lock and double-checks freshness. Good pattern.
Fallback to stale snapshot if upstream fetch raises is correct. No silent crash.
BULK_TTL_S = 600s (10 min) — matches spec: 'au pire 1 appel toutes les 10 min'.

Suggest: add a periodic background refresh task at startup so the first user after TTL expiry doesn't pay the ~1.2s fetch latency (currently the next request triggers a synchronous-ish refresh under the lock). Not critical given response is still acceptable (<2s).
seed_data_creation: None — cache file is rebuilt by the bulk fetch on first call after `rm`.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk architecture is solid: cold start = 1 upstream call with 12 hourly vars (cape, freezing_level_height, lifted_index, soil_temperature_0cm, temperature_2m, temperature_850hPa, vertical_velocity_700hPa, wind_direction_10m, wind_direction_500hPa, wind_speed_10m, wind_speed_300hPa, wind_speed_500hPa). Burst-50 over varied (param,hour) combos → 0 upstream calls, avg 107.6ms / max 187.5ms. Restart-with-cache → 0 upstream calls, response 112ms. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_grid_architecture.py is the regression harness — re-runnable any time; it resets the cache + restarts the backend itself.

evidence.point2_disk_file: 448 KB JSON, all 9 params, 192 locs, 48+ hours
